name: Mild Garlic Butter Steak Bites with Corn on the Cob & Green Beans

instructions.primary_message: Fill a large pot halfway with hot water (from the tap); cover and bring to a boil over high heat.
While the water heats up, remove husks and silks from corn and cut in half crosswise; set aside.
Wash, dry, trim, and halve green beans crosswise.

Once the water is boiling, uncover the pot and reduce heat to medium; use tongs to lower the corn into the water, then add green beans. Cook until veggies are just tender, about 5 minutes. Drain corn and green beans, then return to the pot and cover to keep warm.
Meanwhile, preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, pat the steak dry with paper towels, then cut into 1-inch cubes. Season with salt and paprika.
instructions.secondary_message:
454 g ribeye steak
½ tsp salt
¼ tsp paprika

instructions.primary_message: Once the skillet is hot, add butter and swirl to coat the bottom. Add steak and cook, turning occasionally, until browned on all sides, 2-3 minutes (the steak will not be cooked all the way through). Remove to a plate and set aside. (Reserve skillet with drippings for the next step.)
Return skillet (with drippings) to medium heat, add more butter, and swirl to coat the bottom. Add garlic powder and salt; cook, stirring constantly, until fragrant, 1 minute.
instructions.secondary_message:
butter, unsalted
¼ tsp garlic powder
¼ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Return steak bites to the skillet and toss to coat in the garlic butter. Continue to cook, turning occasionally, until desired doneness, 1-2 minutes for medium. Remove from heat.
To serve, divide corn, green beans, and steak bites between plates; spread corn with butter, then season corn and green beans with salt. Enjoy!
